text: Will Trinidadian and Tobagonian have a higher number of cities than Bissau-Guinean at turn 210?
criteria: Resolves YES if Trinidadian and Tobagonian's number of cities as recorded at the end of turn 210 is strictly greater than Bissau-Guinean's. Equal values resolve NO. The quantity is the same quantity the world report calls Cities.
